A Maze, A Maze, A Maze

Guide the cyan lantern to the magenta beacon. Lime diamonds reveal the map for five seconds.

Find the beacon

  • ◆ Move your cyan lantern with WASD, arrow keys, or the on-screen buttons. Its trail fades behind you.
  • ◇ Collect a lime diamond for a five-second map view. Keep moving while the clock is paused.
  • ◎ Reach the magenta beacon to finish the maze.

Beacon reached

Move with WASD or arrow keys
